verdict.rationale: Turso can be driven without a UI. Its CLI manages databases and API tokens [turso-docs-50]. The Platform API creates, scopes and tears down databases programmatically [turso-docs-60, turso-docs-8]. The docs explicitly suggest automating branching to create a database per pull request [turso-docs-11, turso-docs-18]. Tokens can be scoped and given an expiry, which suits automated clients [turso-docs-56], and local databases run in-process with no server [turso-docs-30]. Missing for 10: an explicit CI pipeline guide or example (e.g. a GitHub Actions workflow), documentation of non-interactive CLI authentication, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
